+                                          re.IGNORECASE|re.ASCII)

+            self.interesting = re.compile(r'</%s(?=[\t\n\r\f />])' % self.cdata_elem,
+                                          re.IGNORECASE|re.ASCII)
 
     def clear_cdata_mode(self):
         self.interesting = interesting_normal
         self.cdata_elem = None
+        self._escapable = True
